fonts.description: Configuration for font settings. This variable is a list of font config objects.

icons.description: Configuration for icon settings. This variable is a list of icon config objects.

main.description: Configuration for main/general settings. This variable is a list of main config objects.

style.description: Name of the style plugin to use. Common options include 'kvantum', 'qtcurve', 'gtk2', 'gtk3', 'breeze'.

theme.description: Name of the Qt6 theme to apply. Common options include 'kvantum', 'breeze', 'oxygen', 'gtk2'.
